note: disgust: action (disgust someone) or the feeling noun?
respect: action (respect someone) or the quality?
smell: also 'give off an odour' (no object)
can: modal; is it an action word?
become: takes a complement, not an undergoer
play: 'play a game' may take an object
live: takes a duration (to nume fawu ka yawu); no verb object
wait: 'wait for X' may take an object
return: transitive use (return a thing) possible
